Handwritten & digital → structured clinical data

Every prescription, read and structured.

Handwritten or digital, in any language, Tata 1mg's prescription engine reads every incoming script, resolves it into clean structured fields, and turns it into clinical and commercial signal. This view spans — across ten specialties, eight prescriber networks, and English plus regional scripts.
